router.route: public commit-pinned GitHub raw mirror plus official R manual

official_documentation.claim_used: For one sample the null probability defaults to 0.5; the implementation is a proportions score test and exposes the Pearson chi-squared statistic.

concise_paraphrase: With one success count x, n trials, null p=0.5, and continuity correction disabled, R Core forms expected counts n/2 and n/2 and sums squared count deviations divided by those expectations. The signed square root reduces algebraically to (2*x-n)/sqrt(n).
role: Primary-software score arithmetic only; no WTI trading efficacy, threshold, frequency, or portfolio claim transfers.
safety: Public read only; no authentication mutation, code execution, source-site write, or raw-source republication.
